name: Guard the Breach (Combat)
body:
You have trained on the front line and are ready for enemies that try to rush past you.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, (base attack bonus +5 or Fighter level 4th).

Benefit(s): When a charging opponent enters a square you threaten they provoke an attack of opportunity from you and opponents may still provoke an attack of opportunity when exiting a square you threaten providing you have one remaining. This feat allows a single movement from an opponent to provoke up to two attacks of opportunity from you during a target’s charge. This feat does not grant additional attacks of opportunity.

Normal: A creature can only provoke an attack of opportunity once from each attacker with a move action.
